scope: review of existing published and local evidence; no rerun of CSV analysis or PostgreSQL

accepted_claims.claim: 99441 distinct order customer_id; 96096 distinct customer_unique_id; count buyers using the latter for this dataset.
accepted_claims.method: independent CSV distinct counts and key checks

accepted_claims.claim: 99224 distinct nonempty review-order pairs; 98410 distinct review IDs; 789 IDs link to multiple orders; 547 orders have multiple review rows.
accepted_claims.method: independent CSV pair and ID distinct counts

accepted_claims.claim: Among 99441 orders, 775 have no items, one has no payment record, and 768 have no review; absence must not automatically be zero.
accepted_claims.method: CSV child-set comparison and review coverage

accepted_claims.claim: 610 products lack category; two existing categories lack translation, distinct from missing category.
Of 96478 delivered orders, 8 lack delivery date and 14 lack approval date; six canceled orders have a delivery date.
Carrier timestamp precedes purchase in 166 of 97658 comparable orders; delivery precedes carrier in 23 of 96475 comparable orders; overlap is not established.

accepted_claims.population: 98665 orders, all statuses, both items and payments present
accepted_claims.method: independent preaggregation by order, CSV Decimal

accepted_claims.claim: For the 98665 comparable orders, joining item and payment rows creates 117601 rows, with 275 orders having multiple rows on both sides.
accepted_claims.method: arithmetic based on CSV cardinalities, not SQL execution

accepted_claims.claim: Independent CSV and Decimal review recorded hashes, counts, keys, references and selected metrics for 8 local files; all eight blob IDs matched previously saved tree evidence, not a newly retrieved tree.

PG 16.15 synthetic test: lifecycle on 10 orders; Q6-Q10 behavioral fixture on 16 orders; clean build, rebuild, fingerprints, intended late rollback, raw fingerprint comparison, answers and check passed within that scope.
The fixture detected two mutations: inclusive to exclusive threshold and an incorrect lateness denominator.
Phase summary marks full Olist and CSV-to-raw equality not run; results from a prior output do not establish a current full-data core pass.

rejected_claims.claim: 366 orders and net difference -1819.51 as the same filtered population
rejected_claims.reason: That net belongs to all 639 exact nonzero differences; strictly greater than one cent yields 366 and -1818.84. Original profiling SQL is unavailable, so its actual method is unknown.

rejected_claims.claim: CSV findings alone prove full current core answers and raw binding
rejected_claims.reason: The CSV oracle is independent of the database; the synthetic phase explicitly records both full Olist and CSV/raw equality not run.

rejected_claims.claim: The current phase has achieved a 129-second full build and 42/42 full-data controls
rejected_claims.reason: Those figures appear on slides 1 and 10 of the pinned presentation; the provided current-phase evidence does not bind them to the current input and SQL.

rejected_claims.claim: The financial differences, date anomalies or multiple ZIP prefixes establish their business causes
rejected_claims.reason: The observations do not establish causes, cash settlement, or a customer move.

rejected_claims.claim: Every finding has been checked with a second independent method
rejected_claims.reason: The evidence identifies specific CSV, fixture and mutation checks; it does not establish this blanket statement for all findings.
